reviews.reason: Verified against all 5 applicable trajectories (toucan dataset with >=2 tool calls): operator returns true for 4 trajectories with consecutive step numbers for tool calls (toucan/7900c4d1..., toucan/bb86a6e1..., toucan/1d93c98a..., toucan/4a2f8d2b... false) — all values match trajectory content. The finding consequence holds: batched trajectories have shorter step counts (6-9 steps) versus non-batched (11-14 steps). The scope correctly returns empty for trajectories with fewer than two tool calls (ultrachat trajectories, correctly excluded). No existing feature in features.csv duplicates this value, and the definition is objective: no judgment required to detect consecutive tool call steps.

Verified against all applicable trajectories: operator returns 0.0 for trajectories with batched tool calls (4 cases), 2.0 for toucan/4a2f8d2b..., 3.0 for toucan/3ae8c7dc... — all counts match the actual assistant messages between tool calls. The finding consequence holds: trajectories with intermediate messages have longer step counts (11,14) versus those with zero (9). The scope correctly returns empty for trajectories with fewer than two tool calls or consecutive batched tool calls. No existing feature duplicates this, and the count of matching assistant messages is unambiguous.
